title: pilosella pseudohybrida
intro: Pilosella pseudohybrida, commonly known as False Oxeye Daisy, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in Pilosella pseudohybrida include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, reducing inflammation, and fighting against infections. The plant's therapeutic actions also make it useful in the treatment of various health conditions, including gastrointestinal issues and respiratory problems.
